new_libraries.name: DevLab_AnalogInterface
new_libraries.author: UNIT Electronics MX
new_libraries.maintainer: Adrian Rabadan, Cesar Bautista, Jonathan Mejorado, Fernando Flores
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the UE0177 Analog-Digital to I2C Sensor Interface using the DevLab Device Protocol (DDP).
new_libraries.paragraph: Reads any analog sensor through the 12-bit ADC of a PY32F003 node over I2C (Device ID 0x0119), exposes a software threshold with hysteresis, and configures the optional PB5 GPIO line as an input, a fixed output or an output that follows the threshold.

new_libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Gas Sensor GM-X02B
new_libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
new_libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the SparkFun Qwiic MEMS gas sensor breakouts built on the Winsen GM-x02B sensor family
new_libraries.paragraph: One library for all nine SparkFun Qwiic MEMS gas sensor boards: GM-102B (NO2), GM-202B (alcohol and smoke), GM-302B (ethanol), GM-402B (methane and propane), GM-502B (VOC), GM-512B (breath odor), GM-602B (hydrogen sulfide, H2S), GM-702B (carbon monoxide, CO) and GM-802B (ammonia, NH3). Reads the Winsen sensing element through the onboard ADC101C021 I2C ADC and provides raw counts, output voltage, sensor resistance, a direction-normalized clean-air gas response, hardware threshold alerts, and hardware peak tracking. Handles the GM-102B's inverted response curve automatically, so one sketch works with any board in the family.
